<#macro eqRow item rowClass>
            <#assign mk = (item.make!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
            <#assign md = (item.model!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
            <#assign dl = (item.length!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
            <#assign dw = (item.width!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
            <#assign dd = (item.depth!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
            

                
${item.status}
                
${(item.srf_id!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.eq_name!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.type!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
<#if mk?has_content>${mk}</#if><#if mk?has_content && md?has_content> / </#if><#if md?has_content>${md}</#if>
                
${(item.description!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.feeder_type!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
<#if dl?has_content || dw?has_content || dd?has_content>${dl} x ${dw} x ${dd}</#if>
                
${(item.equip_height!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.weight!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.azimuth!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.b_end!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.location!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
${(item.inventory_flag!"")?replace("null", "")}
            
        </#macro>

        
        
            

                
                    
                        SITE DETAILS SCHEDULE (SDS)
                        <#if requestJSON.srf.tl_signed == "null">
                            [Subject to Contract / Contract Denied]
                        </#if>
                    
                
                
                
                    
                
            
        
        
        
        
            

                
                    

                        This is an SDS issued pursuant and subject to the
                        ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_name}
                        (the "${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_code}")
                        

                        between Towercom Limited and the
                        ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_party} dated ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_date}
                    
                
            
        

        
        
            
 Site Details 
            

                 Site Name 
                 ${requestJSON.siteDetails.site_name} 
                 Site ID: 
                 ${requestJSON.siteDetails.site_id} 
                 ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_party} Site ID: 
                 ${requestJSON.srf.custrecord_twc_srf_op_site_id} 
            
            

                Site Address:
                
                    <#if requestJSON.siteDetails.address?has_content && requestJSON.siteDetails.address != "null"> ${requestJSON.siteDetails.address} </#if>
                    <#if requestJSON.siteDetails.add_zipcode?has_content && requestJSON.siteDetails.add_zipcode != "null">, ${requestJSON.siteDetails.add_zipcode} </#if>
                    <#if requestJSON.siteDetails.add_county?has_content && requestJSON.siteDetails.add_county != "null">, ${requestJSON.siteDetails.add_county} </#if>
                
            
            

                 Coordinates: 
                 Easting: ${requestJSON.siteDetails.easting} 
                 Northing: ${requestJSON.siteDetails.northing} 
                 Latitude: ${requestJSON.siteDetails.latitude} 
                 Longitude: ${requestJSON.siteDetails.longitude} 
            
        

        
        
            
  Details of the Parties  
            

                 Licensor: 
                 ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_party}: 
            
            

                
                    Name: Towercom Limited
                    

                    Company Number: 439951
                    

                    Registered Office: 2 Grand Canal Square, Dublin 2
                    

                    

                    Whose address for correspondence is:
                    

                    Usher House, Main Street, Dundrum, Dublin 14
                
                
                    Name: ${requestJSON.srf.operator_name}
                    

                    Company Number: ${requestJSON.srf.company_number}
                    

                    Registered Office: ${requestJSON.srf.registered_office}
                    

                    

                    Whose address for correspondence is:
                    

                    ${requestJSON.srf.customer_address}
                
            
            

                 SRF Number: 
                 ${requestJSON.srf.name} 
                 SRF Approved: 
                 ${requestJSON.srf.approval_date} 
            
            

                 Drawing ref: 
                
                 ${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_drawing_ref!"")?replace("null", "none")} 
                 The drawing referenced forms an integral part of the SDS and illustrates the equipment licenced and/or proposed for removal. 
            
            

                 Site Access Reference Documents 
                 ${(requestJSON.srf.site_access_doc!"")?replace("null", "")} 
            

        

        
        
        
            
            

                 Tower Mounted Equipment 
            
            

                Status
                SRF ID
                ID
                Type
                Make / Model
                Description
                Feeder Type
                Dimensions L x W x D (mm)
                Height (m)
                Weight (kg)
                Azimuth
                B-End
                Location
                Flag
            
            

            
            <#list requestJSON.srfItems as srfItems>
                <#if srfItems.equip_class != "3">
                    <@eqRow item=srfItems rowClass="rowTme" />
                    <#list srfItems.items as srfSubItem>
                        <@eqRow item=srfSubItem rowClass="rowAtme" />
                    </#list>
                    <#list srfItems.feeders as srfSubItem>
                        <@eqRow item=srfSubItem rowClass="" />
                    </#list>
                </#if>
            </#list>
            
        

        
        
            
                

                     Ground/Indoor Equipment 
                
                

                    Status
                    SRF ID
                    ID
                    Type
                    Description
                    
                    Length (mm)
                    Depth (mm)
                    Height (mm)
                    Location
                    Flag
                
            
            
                <#list requestJSON.srfItems as srfItems>
                    <#if srfItems.equip_class == "3">
                        

                            ${srfItems.status}
                            ${(srfItems.srf_id!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.eq_name!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.type!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.description!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.length!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.width!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.depth!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.location!"")?replace("null", "")}
                            ${(srfItems.inventory_flag!"")?replace("null", "")}
                        
                    </#if>
                </#list>
            
        

        
        
            

                 Power Supply 
            
            

                 Towercom Temp Supply Required: 
                 ${requestJSON.srf.power_supply_required} 
            
            

                 Other (please specify): 
                ${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_power_supply_notes!"")?replace("null", "")?replace("\n", "
")}
            
        

        
        

        
            

                 Fibre 
            
            

                 Fibre Rights: 
                 <#if requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_rights == "T"> Yes <#elseif requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_rights == "F"> No </#if> 
                 Fibre Duct Route: 
                 ${requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_drawing_ref?replace("null", "")} 
            
            

                 Fibre Provider: 
                 ${requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_provider_name?replace("null", "")} 
                 Other Provider: 
                 ${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_provider_other!"")?replace("null", "")} 
            
            

                 Fibre Conditions: 
                 ${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fibre_notes!"")?replace("null", "")} 
            

        

        
        
        
            

                
                    Licence Fees
                
            

            

                
                    Previous Licence Fee:
                
                
                    €${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fee_prev!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
                
                    Fee Reduction:
                
                
                    €${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fee_reduction!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
                
                    Fee Uplift:
                
                
                    €${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fee_uplift!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
                
                    Licence Fee:
                
                
                    €${(requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_fee_new!"")?replace("null", "")}
                
            
            

                
                    

                        Commencement Date:
                    
                
                
                    ${requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_comm_date}
                
            
            

                
                    
                    <#if requestJSON.sdsCondition_1?has_content>
                        <#list requestJSON.sdsCondition_1.conditions as condition>
                            
                            
${(condition.description!"")}
                            
                            <#list condition.fields as conditionField>
                                

                                    ${conditionField.label}: ${conditionField.value}
                                
                            </#list>
                            
                        </#list>
                    </#if>

                
            
        

        
        
            

                
                    SDS Conditions
                
            
            

                
                    
                        

                            
                                1. This SDS becomes effective on the SDS commencement date and supersedes any previous SDS in respect of this site.
                            
                        
                        

                            
                                2. The effective date for additional equipment is the date the SRF is approved.
                            
                        
                        

                            
                                3. The effective date for equipment removals is the date the equipment is removed.
                            
                        
                    
                
            

            
            

                
                    
                    <#assign addCond = (requestJSON.sds.custrecord_twc_sds_add_cond!"")?replace("null", "")?trim>
                    <#if addCond?has_content && addCond != "-">
                        

                            Additional SRF Specific Conditions:
                        
                        

                            ${addCond}
                        
                    </#if>
                    <#if requestJSON.sdsCondition_2?has_content>
                        <#list requestJSON.sdsCondition_2.conditions as condition>
                            
${(condition.description!"")}
                            
                                <#list condition.fields as conditionField>
                                    

                                    ${conditionField.label}: ${conditionField.value}
                                    
                                </#list>
                            
                        </#list>
                    </#if>

                
            

        


    <#if requestJSON.srf.client_signed != "null">
        
        
            

                
                    Signed for ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_party}
                
            
            

                
                    Electronically signed on behalf of ${requestJSON.agreement.custrecord_twc_agreement_party} by
                    ${requestJSON.srf.client_singed_by} on ${requestJSON.srf.client_signed}.
                
            
        
    </#if>

    <#if requestJSON.srf.tl_signed != "null">
        
        
            

                
                    Signed for Towercom
                
            
            

                
                    Electronically signed on behalf of Towercom by
                    ${requestJSON.srf.tl_signed_by} on ${requestJSON.srf.tl_signed}.
                
            
        
    </#if>

        
        

            ${requestJSON.siteDetails.site_name}_${requestJSON.srf.customer_name}_${requestJSON.sds.name}_${requestJSON.srf.approval_date}
